Build Laya questions

Source: R/questions.R
laya_question.Rd

Laya answers three kinds of typed question about a state in one forward pass:

Usage

laya_choice(instructions, ..., .options = NULL)

laya_score(instructions, levels)

laya_noul(instructions, if_false = NULL, if_true = NULL)

Arguments

instructions

The question, as a string. A list is also accepted and is serialized to JSON, as the Python SDK does for structured instructions.

...

For laya_choice(), the options: either named arguments (label = "description") or unnamed labels without descriptions. Option order matters: the model scores one marker per option, in order.

.options

Alternatively, the options as a named character vector or list (labels with descriptions), or an unnamed character vector (labels only).

levels

For laya_score(), the levels from lowest to highest, as a character vector or a list of structured levels.

if_false, if_true

For laya_noul(), optional descriptions of what the false and true sides mean.

Value

A laya_question object.

Details

  • laya_choice(): pick one label from a fixed set of options.

  • laya_score(): place the state on an ordinal scale (levels lowest first); the answer is the expected level, a number between 0 and the number of levels minus one.

  • laya_noul(): a yes/no statement; the answer is the calibrated probability that it holds.

Combine questions into a set with laya_questions().

See also

laya_questions(), laya_preset()

Examples

laya_choice(
  "Which department should handle this request?",
  billing = "invoices, payments, refunds",
  technical = "bugs, outages, system errors",
  other = "everything else"
)
#> <laya_question> choice Which department should handle this request?  [3 options: billing, technical, other]
laya_choice("What is this about?", "coding", "writing", "other")
#> <laya_question> choice What is this about?  [3 options: coding, writing, other]
laya_score("How urgent is this request?", c("not urgent", "soon", "blocking"))
#> <laya_question> score  How urgent is this request?  [3 levels]
laya_noul("Is this email a phishing attempt?",
          if_false = "a legitimate email", if_true = "phishing or fraud")
#> <laya_question> noul   Is this email a phishing attempt?  [yes/no]
